metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently underestimates true price spikes, especially in early 30-day horizon; adjust forecast upward by 1–2% for any spike above 40.00.
- Forecast mean reverts too quickly after spikes; delay mean reversion by 2–3 periods to match true price persistence.
- Model overreacts to recent low prices, overshooting downward in 30d horizon; cap downward corrections at 1.5% below recent 18-day low.
- Sentiment history is flat (0.00) in all examples — no sentiment-driven bias detected; ignore sentiment as a correction factor unless event context changes.
- True outcomes show strong upward momentum in 30d horizon after initial 18-day low; model fails to capture this momentum; increase forecast slope by 0.5–1.0% per period after 18-day low.
- Model underestimates late-period corrections (last 5–7 days of 30d); add 0.5–1.0% upward bias for final 5–7 days if true outcome shows downward trend.
